key_insight: SpectralCanary embeds shared low-frequency visual traces into image collections so later model outputs can reveal potential use in text-to-image fine-tuning.
engineering_relevance: It offers a lightweight dataset-use auditing pipeline without caption changes, auxiliary generation, or per-image optimization.
method: Blend a fixed canary image into every collection image using a smooth low-pass mask.
Release the marked images with unchanged captions.
Apply a lightweight verifier to suspect-model outputs to detect the transferred signal.
evidence_signal: Across eight Pokémon tests, SpectralCanary averaged 91.1% per-generation TPR at 1% FPR and 94.8% model-level accuracy using 30 generations; across five datasets with SD3.5, it averaged 92.4% TPR with SSIM 0.989 and LPIPS 0.022.
watch_item: Auditing requires marking images before release, and robustness beyond the evaluated architectures, transformations, and adaptive attacks remains unestablished.
paper_title: SpectralCanary: Embarrassingly Simple Low-Frequency Traces for T2I Dataset-Use Auditing
